company.name: Carbonfact
company.shortDescription: Fast, scalable life-cycle assessments to help fashion brands lower their scope 3 emissions.
company.description: Carbonfact is a software running fast life-cycle assessments to help fashion brands lower their scope 3 emissions. The company currently serves more than 150 fashion brands and works with major fashion retailers like Yoox Net A Porter and La Redoute.

productsAndServices.description: Software that calculates and manages greenhouse gas emissions across Scope 1, 2, and 3 for apparel and footwear brands, providing detailed, activity-based carbon accounting and reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Carbonfact Carbon Accounting Software

productsAndServices.description: A platform that automates detailed life cycle assessments for apparel and footwear products, calculating environmental footprints at the SKU level using industry standards.
productsAndServices.name: Product Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) Engine

productsAndServices.description: A service that automates sustainability reporting for apparel and footwear brands, generating audit-ready reports compliant with CSRD, CDP, and other regulatory frameworks.
productsAndServices.name: Compliance and Reporting Automation

productsAndServices.description: Tools that integrate environmental data into product design and sourcing processes, enabling simulation of emissions impacts and decarbonization scenario modeling.
productsAndServices.name: Eco-Design and Decarbonization Planning Tools

productsAndServices.description: A system that consolidates, cleans, and enriches product and supply chain data from multiple sources, automating data import and filling gaps for accurate carbon accounting.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Data Ingestion and Management

productsAndServices.description: A free database of 300+ fully disaggregated life cycle assessment datasets on fashion’s environmental impact.
productsAndServices.name: Carbonfact fashion LCA database

insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
